text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While taking a break in the cafeteria,
fatigue
settles in, and I begin to feel
lethargic and
generally unmotivated...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Well, if this isn't an overlong Nickerchen you're taking. Stay any longer, and the sun will set on you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Addressing me in this peculiar manner is
Tanino
Gimlet. I don't recognize the
term she used, but
she must be
commenting on my unusually long
break.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Seems you've lost your way and
are
maundering about the Labyrinth.
choice_data_list: I just can't find the motivation...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Very well. As you seem incapable of
extracting
yourself from that trap, I shall
forge you a
stairway to lead you back to
this world.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A healthy shot or seven of lime juice, a
dash of
spice...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: There. I call this one, "Flower of Evil."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She slides me a non-alcoholic cocktail,
and I
make to take a sip of it...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The moment the glass reaches my lips,
my entire
mouth is overcome by a
numbing sensation.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! That's right! Cry aloud! Bellow
in
discomfort! Agonize in pain!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
To subject you to the clarity of the
present.
choice_data_list: Why would you eat something this spicy...?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Pain triggers the immediacy of "now"—it
forces
the present to the forefront of
your mind and
compels you to feel the
moment.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: And it is only by pursuing the now that you'll find strength and speed and ideas that transcend running.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Do you not feel it? The surge of strength
which
has now welled up in you? Or the
dizzyingly fast
influx of new ideas in
your mind?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that she mentions it, I do feel
different
somehow...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha ha! I thought as much! I can hear it

myself—the way your brawn is just
bursting at the
seams!
choice_data_list: I think I might be feeling the power well up!
I think my brain is finally starting to work!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
With that power, you should be able to
slay the
Minotaur and flee the Labyrinth!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I will leave you with the thread of
Ariadne... Now,
draw your sword! And
proceed to battle!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha ha! I thought as much! I can hear it

myself—the sound of your thoughts
accelerating!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Surpass the mythos, Renaissance, and
romance!
Fear not the grotesque! Lay
bare your egotism!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: You and I are right here in the era of the now!
